verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training-data opt-out, a data-use policy, or a zero-retention setting for OpenCode or OpenCode Zen. Local-model support and routing through an internal AI gateway are adjacent arrangements, not an opt-out control. The community telemetry report concerns telemetry rather than model training, so it does not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
